messages.subject: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are delighted to assist Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and remain eager to serve all your requirements from our extensive product range.

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €4.96 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, and a contract term of 12 months. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

To give you complete visibility into our underlying costs, please note that LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost. 

As your trusted partner, we pride ourselves on exceptional distributor service and look forward to continuing our successful business relationship.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your feedback regarding our offer. We always appreciate hearing from you and value our ongoing business relationship with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH. 

Unfortunately, we are unable to accommodate a price reduction for this renewal. Our initial offer of €4.96 per unit must stand as our final position. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot), so please decide accordingly.

To summarize, our offer includes a price of €4.96 per unit, a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, and a contract term of 12 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 7 days.

We trust these terms continue to support your operational needs, and we look forward to receiving your decision soon.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

timeouts.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for staying in touch with Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH. We always appreciate the opportunity to work alongside Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and support your ongoing requirements with our broad range and high service standards.

Regarding our negotiation, without movement from your side we cannot move either. 

For your review, our current Angebot stands at a price of €4.96 per unit, a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, and a contract term of 12 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. 

We remain at your disposal should you wish to discuss how we can move forward together.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH
